acceptanceCriteria: The revision index admits .mts and .cts files as text (internal/contextindex/index.go textSuffixes), or a recorded decision explains why not.
The appmap V1-1061 import closure resolves a side-effect-imported .mts/.cts module that only reads a state table instead of failing closed, with a failing-before test.
Any index digest or receipt change caused by the wider text set is repinned and recorded.
body: Found closing Codex round 15 on V1-1061 (claude/v1-1061-appmap-enum-barrel ef2ca8db): internal/contextindex/index.go textSuffixes omits .mts and .cts, so indexed sources of those extensions have no content. The appmap injected-table closure therefore fails closed (UNKNOWN) on every .mts/.cts module even when it only reads the table. Expected: ESM/CJS TypeScript modules are indexed like .ts. Actual: they are skipped as non-text. Precision loss only; no false certainty.
title: Index .mts/.cts sources as text so appmap closures can read them
